domain:skills#2 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcTAJajXtiVBRiECvT6

Carrier note, from contract review 6820943647 on PR #32682 (finding N3). Whichever letter you rule, this card carries two follow-ups owed to ruling A, not only under A:

- `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` §4 line 286 says 「另立 `domain:skills` 卡,⛔ 不进退役 PR」, with no carve-out for additions. A rename whose replacement is a top-level key or a bound member gets opposite instructions from that line and from the new `lanes/skills.md` exception. The case fails closed, as a red PR or a stop, never a wrong landing. The repair is text consistency in that file and needs no ruling. It lands as the `domain:skills` follow-up PR, under any letter.
- The Tier H cost (every PR that uses the exception touches `skills/**`, so it lands by the maintainer's hand) is listed in this card's body for your read. It changes no option.
